subject: Tiered embedding fallback alliance onboarding — Pinecone + S3 pilot
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@pinecone.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Pilot: tiered embedding fallback for S3 + Pinecone — kickoff request

Hi Alex,

Quick note following our booth chat at VectorSummit — thanks for the time. We’d like to stand up a small pilot to validate a tiered embedding strategy where Pinecone is primary for low-latency lookups and S3-based pgvector (cold tier) acts as an automatic fallback for evicted vectors and archival retrievals.

Scope we’re aiming for:
- Failure/resiliency: automatic fallthrough from Pinecone to S3 for misses/evictions
- Consistency: TTL and versioning semantics for reindexed embeddings
- Observability: per-request source tracing and cost attribution
- Performance targets: <35ms P95 for warm lookups, <200ms for fallback hits

Can you share a brief architecture sketch and any requirements on SDKs or auth patterns? I’ve attached a draft pilot scope (pilot-scope-draft.pdf) for your review — mainly focused on a 6-week technical pilot with a single Redwood tenant.

Proposed next step: 30m kickoff w/ engineering + solutions next week. Avail: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks,

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Engineer, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot-scope-draft.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@pinecone.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: tiered embedding fallback for S3 + Pinecone — kickoff request

Hi Soojin — great meeting you too.

This sounds feasible and aligned with a pattern we’ve seen. A few quick notes:
- We can support prefix-based routing for lookups so Redwood can implement a deterministic fallthrough. No SDK changes required for basic reads; we'll provide a sample adapter.
- Evictions: Pinecone can emit eviction webhooks. We'll work with your engineers on an ingestion path into your S3 cold store (or we can push to a staging bucket).
- Auth: recommend service principal with scoped keys per-tenant; we'll share a short-runbook.
- Instrumentation: we'll add a header to responses to indicate hit="pinecone" or hit="cold-s3" for tracing.

I attached a short design note (pinecone-fallback-arch.pdf) and a proposed availability window — Tue/Wed 9–11 PT work for our solutions folks.

Happy to join the kick-off. If you want a contract/commercial stub, I can loop sales but this pilot is typically a technical PS with a small travel-free credit.

— Alex
Alex Turner
Partner Solutions Engineer
Pinecone

Attachments: pinecone-fallback-arch.pdf (PDF)
